g.text: — Chat, source handoffs, live runs, and control actions.
Conversation | What is 2 plus 2? Verify on...
Each tab runs its own agent — up to 3 in parallel (change in Settings > Console Behavior).
Wait, I'll check if I can use `calculator` to "verify" and then answer.
But the user said "Do not use tools".
If I don't use tools, I can't use `calculator`.
But I can't "use" a tool in the final response to the user, only in the turn.
If I can't use a tool, I can't "verify" in a way that the user sees a tool call.
Unless "Verify" refers to my internal thought process.
Ctrl+Shift+F focus | F6 next pane | Shift+F6 previous pane | F1 help | Enter send / queue | Y trace | Ctrl+P · Ctrl+Q
